products.name: tiun.
products.tagline: Auth, billing, and payments for AI builders
products.description: One system for auth, payments, customer data, and analytics. One command to install. Launch a paid product the same day you start building.

products.name: Voiskey
products.tagline: AI voice typing that sounds right in every app
products.description: Voiskey starts from what you meant, not just what you said. Speak a rough thought and it comes back shaped for where it's going and who's reading it: casual with a friend, composed with a colleague, technical with an AI. It arrives 5x faster than typing, cleaned up and ready to send, while you still sound like you. Voiskey is now available on iOS, macOS, Android, and Windows, in over 100 languages. It's free to start. Join during launch and get a free month of Pro.

products.name: Kilo Code for iOS and Android
products.tagline: Start coding agents, control sessions, review PRs. Anywhere.
products.description: Run Cloud Agents, control VS Code and CLI sessions, review Pull Requests, and respond to coding agents from your iPhone, iPad, or Android.

products.name: siift
products.tagline: Turn AI noise into better business decisions
products.description: Building a business with AI can quickly become a mess of chats, tools, ideas, and conflicting advice. siift turns that noise into a living map of your business, connecting strategy, evidence, decisions, and results in one place. From validation and build strategy to GTM and growth, our AI uses your evolving business context and proven processes to challenge assumptions, identify risks, and help you focus on what matters next.

products.name: OpenAI Agents API
products.tagline: Cloud agents, run on OpenAI's Codex harness
products.description: OpenAI's managed version of the Codex harness to build cloud agents with one API call instead of your own orchestration. Handles long sessions, smart tool use, and subagents working in parallel. Runs on OpenAI or partner sandboxes. No extra fees beyond token and tool usage. Open source harness, public beta now.

products.name: Anthropologic
products.tagline: The zero distance consumer research platform.
products.description: Traditional research is deep but slow. Social listening is fast but shallow. LLMs are fluent but culturally blind. Anthropologic reads the whole internet through our 'Human Context Protocol' to uncover consumer, category and cultural truths. Nine workflows, 239 markets, 100+ languages. Research, innovation and foresight answers in minutes.

products.name: Axari
products.tagline: Assign your security busywork to your AI twin
products.description: Your Axari AI twin understands your security world, works across your tools and teams, and keeps work moving until it is actually done. Assign it a goal, let it work proactively, or give it recurring responsibilities – all from within Slack or MS Teams. Attackers aren't going to use less AI, neither should you. You + your AI twin = indefatigable.

products.name: PeekPaste
products.description: PeekPaste is a native clipboard manager for Mac that stays out of your way until you need it. Push your pointer against the screen edge and your clipboard slides in. Find text, code, links, images, colors and files, search inside screenshots with on-device OCR, pin and organize clips, or open the full Library when you need more. Everything stays on your Mac - no accounts, analytics, telemetry or cloud clipboard service.

products.name: Narrative
products.tagline: AI-first video editor, just describe edits & refine in chat
products.description: Narrative brings video editing, custom motion graphics, and reference-video style matching into one interface. Upload your footage, describe your edit, and keep refining through chat. Add music, sound effects, and transitions, or get inspiration from reference videos. From podcast clips to launch videos, create without learning Premiere or After Effects. We handle rendering and storage. Our launch video was made entirely in Narrative.

products.name: Thoughts for Mac
products.tagline: Capture notes from your menubar using text, images or voice
products.description: Thoughts is a menubar app for your Mac which helps you keep notes quickly using text, images and voice. Add your favorite agent API key and it'll also help transcribe audio, context images to text and help do simple text-tranforms like capitalization, translations and spelling fixes. Think of it as a fun small multi-tool for your menubar.

products.name: Buddy AI Access (MCP)
products.tagline: Your agent needs more than your repo
products.description: Give AI agents secure access to your infrastructure and workflow. With Buddy MCP agents can run pipelines, inspect logs, deploy apps, create sandboxes, publish artifacts and manage domains. Control exactly what they can access with workspace permissions and tool scopes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot and other MCP clients.

products.name: DynamicLake 2.0
products.tagline: Dynamic Island for Mac with 3rd Live Activities and more
products.description: DynamicLake - Dynamic Island for Mac · Plugins · Notifications · Drag and drop · Converter · Calls · Airdrop · Timer · and more

products.name: Mac Duo
products.tagline: Turn your display into frosted glass as you close the lid
products.description: A macOS app that turns your display into frosted glass as you close the lid. Driven by the hinge sensor, so it moves at the speed of your hand.

products.name: FATHER
products.tagline: A Mac dashboard for site traffic, deploys, uptime, and SEO
products.description: A mission-control dashboard for teams shipping on Vercel. Connect your account and every project fills in live: traffic, deploys, uptime, and PageSpeed scores. Search Console and Bing show clicks, rankings, and indexing. SSL and domain renewals get a countdown, and failing GitHub checks get flagged. When a build fails, the menu-bar F turns red and a notification fires, even with the window closed, so you know a site's down before your clients do. Tokens stay on your Mac. One-time purchase.

products.name: Multimodal Agents by Sierra
products.tagline: AI agents that switch between voice, text, and visuals
products.description: Sierra's multimodal agents bring voice, text, and visuals into the same customer conversation. Voice is for explaining what you need, a visual for comparing options side by side, and text for referencing something later. Instead of picking just one, the agent automatically shifts between modes as the conversation needs.
